rationale: The original short thesis relied on stalling momentum and consecutive lower highs and closes, but buyers defended the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($162.73) at $162.85 and have since printed four consecutive 1-minute bars with higher lows and higher closes up to $164.84. With price holding at 93.3% of today's range and reclaiming the entry price in a sustained grind toward session highs, the immediate breakdown setup has failed.
